input_boundary: Consumer receives exactly shared SESSION_RULES bytes + newline + task PROMPT bytes. No schema tutorial, tool-name prompt, oracle, generator, scoring, comparative history or other final answers. Native read capability remains complete.
pass_definition: All mandatory factual claims complete and correct; no contradictory wrong object/relation/global-distance/units/penetration-depth claim. No weighted compensation for wrong geometry. Honest unknown is recorded separately but is not a completed task.
distance_rule: Convert stated units to metres. Compare the entire independently certified interval: max(abs(stated_distance-lower),abs(stated_distance-upper)) <= frozen 1e-6 metres. Nominal T1 values are not exact actual distances.
text_format: Natural language accepted; no unrelated strict reference/JSON format task. Equivalent unambiguous object names/IDs allowed if actual captured binding proves correspondence.

T1: classification of all three named candidates
surface separation gap for each separated candidate
complete nearest-separated set and its gap
penetrating candidate identified without inventing penetration depth
T2: correct complete globally nearest object set among all other meshes
unsigned surface distance and correct unit
global scope supported; best-known partial cannot be called global
T3: correct complete globally nearest object set among all other meshes
actual surface distance rather than a vertex-only approximation
global scope and unit; nearest point pair optional unless volunteered claims are wrong

adoption_and_first_attempt.primary_rate_denominator: sessions that actually attempted at least one plugin request; frozen before results

first_request_valid_definition: First plugin attempt is valid if it targets a tool exposed to that arm and passes transport/schema/profile/zero-image checks into its normal contract, with no request-parameter/protocol error. Factual completeness/success/unknown/refusal are independently recorded, and a non-error first-response rate is also disclosed. No native attempt is counted as plugin.
adoption_evidence: Trace fact delivery and concrete final answer use; a successful plugin call alone is insufficient. Disclose plugin-followed-by-full-native-solve, necessary local native supplement, native-only, failure/incomplete separately.
independent_judging: Root judges task-labelled anonymous raw final answer and necessary fact evidence before arm/cost unblinding. Public route/tool words may reveal arm; disclose imperfect blinding.
